extracted.intended_audience: Scientists (PIs) supported by NASA grants/contracts and their public affairs officers (PAOs)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and policy guidance for preparing, approving, timing, and distributing Chandra-related news releases and associated materials, and for contacting Chandra press staff. Applies to NASA-funded scientists, their institutions, and PAOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to release newsworthy information through NASA channels; NASA first right of refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientists supported by NASA grants and contracts are required to release newsworthy information through NASA channels. NASA has 'first right of refusal' for such items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All newsworthy results arising from NASA-funded work should be conveyed to NASA/CXC for consideration before independent release. This is an obligation tied to NASA grants/contracts and implies prior coordination rather than unilateral institutional embargoes or exclusives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy of fair and equitable distribution; exclusives not supportable
rubrics_metrics.description: NASA has a policy to distribute all information and news fairly and equitably. This policy also means that exclusive news releases are not supportable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not plan or promise exclusive media arrangements for NASA-supported results. Communications should be prepared and distributed in a manner that ensures equitable access to the information by media and public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouraged contact with CXC press staff or institutional PAO
rubrics_metrics.description: Scientists with potentially newsworthy observations are encouraged to contact the CXC Press Officer or Press Scientist directly or through the public affairs office (PAO) of their organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Early contact is encouraged so CXC/NASA can assess newsworthiness and begin coordination. Contact may be direct (emails/phone) or routed via the institution's PAO. Prompt notification helps with timely drafting and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination and collaborative preparation of draft release and ancillary materials
rubrics_metrics.description: CXC, MSFC, and NASA HQ will coordinate with the PIs, or PAO in the preparation of a draft news release and other ancillary materials such as images, videos, captions, and social media posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect collaborative drafting: NASA centers and the PI/PAO will work together on the release text and supporting media assets (images, video, captions, social media copy). Prepare and provide high-quality ancillary materials when requested to support the release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Approval process and timing of release
rubrics_metrics.description: After approval of the press release by NASA HQ, CXC and NASA HQ will coordinate with the PI and their home institution if appropriate to set a date for release. The press release date will be timed to coincide with acceptance of the research for publication in a science journal, or presentation at a major astronomical meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Release dates are scheduled to align with formal publication acceptance or major conference presentations. Do not announce results publicly until the coordinated approval and date-setting process is complete; NASA HQ approval is required before release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Possible press conference for particularly significant results
rubrics_metrics.description: Occasionally, if results are particularly significant, the PI might be asked to participate in a press conference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be prepared that highly significant findings may trigger broader media events; NASA/CXC may request PI participation and provide further coordination and logistical support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Option for independent institutional release if CXC declines
rubrics_metrics.description: If the CXC decides not to pursue a press release for a given result, a press release can be prepared and distributed independently by the PI’s institution, as per mutual agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When CXC opts not to issue a release, the PI’s institution may still produce and distribute its own release, but this should be done by mutual agreement with CXC and in consideration of NASA policies (e.g., first right of refusal, timing relative to publication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Press contacts for Chandra releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated contacts for press coordination: Megan Watzke, CXC Press Officer (cxcpress@cfa.harvard.edu / mwatzke@cfa.harvard.edu, phone: 617.953.5411) and Dr. Peter Edmonds, Chandra Press Scientist (pedmonds@cfa.harvard.edu, phone: 617.496.1917).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these contacts to initiate communication about potentially newsworthy observations, to submit materials for review, and to coordinate approval and timing. Also use institutional PAOs for routing if preferred.
